title: This Bug Wears Up to 20 Dead Ants as a Disguise

scenes.text: This bug wears a coat of dead ants.
It's the ant-snatching assassin bug from East Africa and Malaysia.
It stabs an ant, injects paralyzing saliva, and sucks it dry.
Then it glues up to 20 empty ant bodies onto its back.
In a test, jumping spiders attacked bare bugs about ten times more often.
The deadliest disguise is a pile of its own victims.

description:
The ant-snatching assassin bug sticks up to 20 dead ants onto its back as camouflage.
In tests, jumping spiders attacked bugs without the ant coat about ten times more often.
Would this disguise fool you?
first_comment: What is the weirdest disguise you know of in nature?
